correctness.rationale: Gaussian conditional density, occupation-density mollification and independent-copy integration produce the nonnegative exact series. The endpoint derivative is strictly negative; high-noise first-chaos C2 convergence and derivative inequalities establish eventual unique maximizer; a perturbative scalar equation yields the two-term timing and risk expansions. Separate two-dimensional integration and derivative tests pass; finite computation is not used for infinite conclusions.

value.rationale: Local time is a canonical nonlinear path functional whose approximation from sparse measurements is consequential. The exact all-noise risk and sharp noise-dependent placement (an interior optimum a distance asymptotic to 1/(3 eta) from the endpoint, with a next-order correction) give an actionable quantitative design law and reveal information loss of order eta^-2, without presupposing a broad downstream theorem.
